text:
Type: plaid cotton throw with fringe
Use: covering a sofa, an armchair or a bed, keeping warm; living room, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, bohemian, traditional
Materials: soft woven cotton with a checked pattern, twisted multicolor fringe
Colors: light beige, soft pink, lavender grey, hints of green
Shape: rectangular throw with a large open plaid of pink and grey stripes, long twisted tasseled fringe on the ends, light and drapey
Feel: sweet, relaxed, soft, cheerful
Goes with: white or cream sofas, pastel cushions, light wood; cottage, farmhouse or bohemian bedrooms and living rooms
